source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: How to Go Through Red-Thread Barrier - GameRant
source_excerpt:
After arriving in the Weeping Creek Valley, players will eventually find their path blocked by a red thread barrier in Phantom Blade Zero . Since the mountain path is blocked, you'll need to figure out a way to release these threads, or at least create an opening for Soul to pass through and progress to the next area. Here's how players can pass through the red thread barrier in Phantom Blade Zero .
How to Go Through the Red Thread Barrier in Phantom Blade Zero
After you encounter the blocked path with red threads, turn left and follow the trail of red strings to the other section of the area. So, grab the chain, swing across the gap, and head through the cavern to the open area on the left.
Once you're in the open area, you'll need to clear out a few enemies first. Once you're done, make sure to interact with the " Broken Puppet Valley " bell first. This will clear out some fog of war and activate a spawn point right before the enemy you need to defeat, wrapped in red strings.
Don't forget to pick up the document from the body near the bell under a tree to start the Four Axes quest . There's another quest-related document inside the hut opposite the bell.
The enemy will be carrying a spiked shield, which will be a bit problematic to deal with, as hitting the shield will inflict bleed on Soul. You'll need to wait for the enemy to perform a blue or red attack , and use the opportunity to Ghost Step behind it and land some good hits.
Once the shielded enemy is defeated, the red thread barrier in Phantom Blade Zero will open up a bit, allowing Soul to pass through. Before you make your way back to the barrier, make sure to pick up some important documents and materials inside the houses in the area. One of those documents will start the "Four Fierce Axes" quest.
